# Charwak Deshpande
## Business Loan Consultant | MSME Finance | Working Capital | Industrial Finance

Website
https://charwakcd.github.io/bhosari-loan/

Description

This website provides educational information and consulting guidance related to business finance for MSMEs, manufacturers, traders, service companies and industrial enterprises located around Pune, Maharashtra.

The content covers business loans, working capital finance, term loans, machinery loans, project finance, expansion funding, loan against property, CGTMSE funding and other banking solutions suitable for eligible businesses.

The information is organized according to major industrial locations around Pune to help business owners identify relevant financing options.
